title: 第11章  论武徒第12章  铁布衫检测定品
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
尽管苏锦跟苏老实性格迥异。
但给苏青办酒这事，却都是出奇热切。
原因苏青也知道。
三年前，苏家也办了一场酒，为庆祝他以创武特长生身份进入第一高中。
当时鞭炮齐鸣，锣鼓喧天，苏家人穿的花枝招展，邀了八方来客。
那场面有多大，之后的三年，苏老实，苏锦等人就有多窘迫。
谁都知道，他们苏家出了位假天才，高中三年毫无建树，泯然众人。
不，连众人都比不上，没让他退学，都算李校长心慈手软了。
也因此，苏青对这位三年来，看到他就叹气的老李校长，始终充满敬意。
毕竟，小老头那两鬓白发，可都是为他白的。
一入苏青家门，李源表现的比苏老实，王慧兰得知消息时还要激动：
“我冤啊，三年来，我都不敢说我没收你家礼。
宁愿背着个贪污受贿的罪名，也不敢承认是我看走了眼，特招了个武道废材。
现在好了，我老李没有看走眼，你小子果然有点东西的！
快，快跟我去武道局登记，那武道A之前还不给铁布衫模拟定品。
现在武道功德都来了，我看看它还敢不敢嚣张！”
三年河东，三年河西，急着扬眉吐气的李源，连武道a的脸都想打。
催着苏青跟他一起去武学登记。
“这是正事，武学登记之后，就能认证创武师身份。
另外还可以在武道网上架武学，扩充武学影响力，后续或许还有武道功德进账。

至少，有人订阅武学，也能贴补些家用。”
苏锦把茶杯一放，站起身就要跟李源跟苏青一起去武道局。
那是他任职的单位，是他扬眉吐气最好的舞台！
苏青从善如流，跟着二人就往武道局去。
走到楼下，心神立刻被二伯的座驾妖骨战车所吸引。
一整具妖物骸骨打造的森白战车，犹如活物般散发着幽幽冷气。
前后两个轮胎，就有半人多高，哥布林那样的魔物，直接碾过去就成。
大灯位置由一块棱形晶体取代，这是邪照宝石，能照出隐形单位跟邪祟之物。
至于车体内部，应该还有武具装置，这就需要机车主人的权限才能开启了。
对二伯这座驾，苏青看了无数次，也羡慕无数次。
想着有朝一日能骑乘这样的机车，驰骋于异域星界战场，也不辜负这一身男儿热血，武道热肠。
“这车阴寒之气对你身体不好，别坐，跟我走着去，几步路的事。”
李源摆手，让苏锦骑车先走，而他则带着苏青，慢慢往武道局踱步。
一路上，这位老校长，没少给他提建议。
“我听我家那口子说，你想进第一武院当老师？
有些着急了，铁布衫你打磨三年，才勉强创出来，短时间内，如何能创出第二门来？
听我的，去省城级武院，那里条件比江夏好，竞争也没总院激烈。
content_en:
Although Su Jin and Su Laoshi have very different personalities.
But when it came to hosting a drink for Su Qing, she was surprisingly enthusiastic.
Su Qing also knew the reason.
Three years ago, the Su family also held a banquet to celebrate his entry into No. 1 High School as a Chongwu Special Immortal.
At that time, firecrackers were blasting, gongs and drums were noisy, and the Su family wore colorful clothes and invited guests from all over the world.
How big that scene was, how embarrassing Su Laoshi, Su Jin and others were in the next three years.
Everyone knows that there is a fake genius in our Su family. He has made no achievements in three years of high school and has been ignored by everyone.
No, he couldn't even compare to everyone else. He didn't let him drop out of school, which is considered to be a soft-hearted act by Principal Li.
Because of this, Su Qing has always been full of respect for Principal Li, who has sighed whenever he saw him for the past three years.
After all, the white hair on the temples of the little old man was all white because of him.
Upon entering Su Qing's house, Li Yuan behaved more honestly than Su. Wang Huilan was even more excited when she learned the news:
"I'm wronged. For three years, I didn't dare to say that I confiscated your family gift.
I would rather be accused of corruption and bribery than admit that I made a mistake and recruited a martial arts waste.
It's okay now. I, Lao Li, didn't make a mistake. You really have something!
Come on, follow me to the martial arts bureau to register. That martial arts A hasn’t given you a mock-up of the iron cloth shirt before.
Now that the martial arts merits are here, let me see if it dares to be arrogant! "
Three years in Hedong and three years in Hexi. Li Yuan, who was eager to feel proud, wanted to hit even the martial arts A in the face.
He urged Su Qing to register at a martial arts school with him.
"This is business. After the martial arts is registered, the identity of the creative martial arts master can be certified.
In addition, you can also list martial arts on the martial arts website to expand the influence of martial arts, and you may gain martial arts merits in the future.
At least, if someone subscribes to martial arts, it can also supplement some family income. "
As soon as Su Jin put down the tea cup, he stood up and went to the martial arts bureau with Li Yuan and Su Qing.
That was the unit he worked for, and it was the best stage for him to be proud and proud!
Su Qing followed Shan Ruliu and followed the two of them to the martial arts bureau.
Walking downstairs, my mind was immediately attracted by the second uncle's demon bone chariot.
The forest white chariot made of a whole monster skeleton exudes a faint cold air like a living creature.
The front and rear tires are as tall as half a person, and monsters like goblins can be easily run over.
The position of the headlight is replaced by a prismatic crystal, which is an evil light gem that can illuminate invisible units and evil objects.
As for the interior of the vehicle, there should be weapons and equipment, which requires the permission of the owner of the motorcycle to open them.
Su Qing had seen and envied the second uncle's car countless times.
I thought that one day I would be able to ride such a motorcycle and ride on the battlefield in the alien star realm, and I would live up to the passion and martial arts of this man.
"The cold and cold air in this car is not good for your health. Don't sit in it. Walk with me. It's only a few steps away."
Li Yuan waved his hand to let Su Jin ride the bicycle first, while he took Su Qing and walked slowly towards the martial arts bureau.
Along the way, the old principal gave him many suggestions.
"I heard from my family that you want to enter the First Martial Arts Academy and become a teacher?
I'm a little anxious. You spent three years polishing Iron Bushan before you could just create it. How can you create a second door in a short period of time?
Listen to me and go to the provincial-level martial arts academy. The conditions there are better than those in Jiangxia, and the competition is not as fierce as the main academy.
